provenance_notes: Fine-tuned with 38 hard-negative images (empty labels) added to the proven 12-image positive training set (8 high-quality + 4 low-quality-lighting pages) -- see cell_detect/make_synthetic_negatives.py and the Non-braille images folder. Adopted as the active default: held-out test mAP50 0.698->0.782, precision 0.743->0.822, recall 0.812->0.841 vs the prior default, AND eliminated every known false-positive case (VS Code screenshot: 32->0 boxes, Sri Lankan ID card: 53->0 boxes, laptop/keyboard photo: 18->0 boxes) with no sign of the positive-page training-count fragility seen elsewhere in this project. Supersedes braille_cell_yolo26n_degraded.onnx as the active default -- that experiment (see cell_detect/CAMERA_DEGRADATION.md) remains a separate, validated-but-mixed result, still bundled as an asset, not combined with this one yet.
flutter_notes: Preprocess: resize letterbox to 1280x1280, RGB, divide by 255. Postprocess: YOLO26 detection head, output already de-duplicated (end-to-end head) -- keep every row above conf_threshold (a page has many cells, unlike the fingertip model which only keeps the single best row). Box centers are the cell centroids.
